meta_description:
33K likes, 486 comments - realhinakhan on September 24, 2026: "Some voyages must begin before the day even begins.

So I started before the waking dawn, and reached the arid, Potala-esque Thiksey Monastery just as the first light of the Sun arrived.

The chants, the atmosphere, the stillness of soulful morning prayers, meditation, everything made the journey to find The Self feel easier than I could have imagined.
Meditation heals me 🙏🏻

I have always found moments to connect with the divine, sometimes by looking outward and sometimes by looking within. The world has so much to offer, both outside and inside us.
Today, that quest found a memorable milestone.

Thank you @utladakhtourism for making it so comfortable for us.. 

#thikseymonastery #reelitfeelit #meditation #healingfromwithin #ReelsWithHK".
